The event offers passionate runners a unique experience across four spectacular routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, and an atmosphere filled with adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people who share your passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of the Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare mountains
Routes in the Baiului Mountains, with aid stations offering water, energy drinks, and fruit
Different start locations for the main races and children’s races, including special routes with gondola transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual chip timing, aid stations with water and fruit, finisher medals, cash and sports equipment prizes, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, and an official photo and video album. Gondola transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. Awards ceremony at 17:00, SuperParty on Saturday evening with DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation gain, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, now in its 15th edition, and promises an enjoyable and challenging experience for runners of all levels.

description: The Craiova Half Marathon is a community-focused fundraising running event organized by the Romanian Association of Young People with Initiative (A.R.T.I.) in collaboration with SightRunning.ro. The event offers timed races for competitive runners over distances of 21 km, 14 km, and 7 km, as well as untimed races and activities for all ages and categories, including wheelchair users and pets. The urban course starts and finishes at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade and consists of 7 km loops, with an elevation gain of 58 m. Participation supports charitable projects in education, health, and social inclusion, making the event an opportunity for solidarity and community involvement.
course_highlights: Urban course starting and finishing at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade
7 km loops: 3 for the half marathon, 2 for the 14 km race, and 1 for the 7 km race
58 metres of elevation gain, with hydration and medical assistance points along the course
additional: Race kits can be collected at Electroputere Mall from October 10–16 and on event day at the Ion Oblemenco Stadium Esplanade between 08:30 and 09:30. The event includes special races for wheelchair users and adaptive sports, as well as untimed races and related activities. Safety measures include security personnel, volunteers, an ambulance with a doctor, and first-aid points. The event has a charitable component, supporting social and educational causes. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and registration is announced as open until October 10, 2026.

name: Timișoara City Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running event held in Timișoara, offering races over a range of distances from 1 km to the full marathon of 42 km. The event promotes freedom and community spirit, inviting runners of all levels to take part and push their limits. With a strong tradition and dedicated training programs, the marathon is a motivating and energizing experience for all participants.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 1 km, 4 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km
Event held in Timișoara, with urban courses
A strong community and personalized training programs
additional: Training programs are available for all the main distances (5 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km), created by an experienced university coach. The event includes free children’s races over short distances. Relay races are also available for the marathon and half marathon. Participants can benefit from marathon training programs, including plans for beginners and intermediate runners, as well as advice on equipment and physical preparation.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of the city of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, turning every kilometer into a symbol of an active, healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic, unifying sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: An urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
A community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event for both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts in Otelec and finishes in Victory Square, offering a unique experience inspired by the story of Eugeniu of Savoy’s arrival. The half marathon and fun runs offer varied routes through the city’s squares, parks, and historic neighborhoods, showcasing local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, a Pasta Party, and the special anniversary race “106 pentru POLI”.
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, in Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines the squares and parks of the Fabric district along the banks of the Bega
The fun runs pass through the parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric district
additional: Race packs are distributed at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. Marathon participants depart by coach for Otelec at 06:30 from Victory Square. Energy products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, a Pasta Party, and the anniversary race “106 pentru POLI” on October 29, 2026, at Stadionul Știința. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children’s race, a 10 km race, and a 21.1 km half marathon, on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, an eco-friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It’s a great opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km race and half marathon
Children’s race on fully safe paved routes closed to vehicle traffic
Hydration stations and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children’s race is free and open to children aged 4 to 13, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on fully safe routes closed to vehicle traffic. A parent or guardian must be present with participating children throughout the race. Medals, certificates, and product prizes are awarded to all participants, and the adult routes include hydration stations and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes, including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity in the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied courses for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country race, 6 km race, children’s race, Family Run, and a race for people with special abilities, “I CAN TOO!” The courses pass through forests, hills, and historic sites such as the Royal Hațeg Fortress, offering a technical and spectacular experience. The event is praised for its clear course markings and friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Courses through forests and hills, with technical climbs and descents
Passage by the Royal Hațeg Fortress, an iconic historic site
Varied scenery including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and the village of Covragiu
additional: Race kits can be collected between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The 6 km cross-country race, 12 km cross-country race, and half marathon start at 10:00, while the Family Run and “I CAN TOO!” races start at 15:00. Registration for the children’s races and Family Run is also available on site, subject to availability. Due to manufacturing tolerances, runners are advised to choose a T-shirt size smaller than their usual size. The event offers cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Hațeg Country area.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail run in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest. It started in 2018 and has grown to more than 2,400 participants. The event offers four races: a half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, a 6 km fast run, and a non-competitive 3 km Family Run, suitable for runners of all levels. The race focuses on the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, and is organized by a team passionate about running. Participants can join group training sessions at different paces, led by coaches, to prepare for race day.
course_highlights: A 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
A range of races: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and 3 km Family Run
Training sessions organized in groups at different paces
additional: Training sessions are organized in groups at different paces and led by coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive race for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with Asociația Magic and Asociația Zi de Bine. The event includes several race categories, route details and participant instructions, as well as support for social causes.

description: IstritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, taking place on the hills, trails, and forest roads around Istrița Hill and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historic landscapes with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is for both amateur and professional runners, promoting outdoor activity and a passion for mountain running. Participants can choose from three different races, each with its own challenges and attractions.
course_highlights: Routes on the hills and trails around Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and the city of Buzău
Marked routes through forests, along forest roads, and through historic areas with traces of Dacian and Roman history
additional: The race pack includes a race bib, a medal for participants who finish within the specified time, refreshment points and support along the route, isotonic drinks at the start/finish and along the route, race results and an electronic certificate, and filming and audio/video editing. It’s the perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city that remains undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course, ideal for personal records
Green parks along the course
A unique blend of old architecture and modern energy

The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural, scenic and healthy setting, away from paved roads.
course_highlights: Route along the cool trails of Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and a family race
Event held in nature, away from paved roads

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event held in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Revolt of 15 November 1987 by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main event is a 5-kilometre road race along the historic route of the revolt, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races for children, with distances adapted to their ages, promoting physical activity and team spirit. The event is organized by Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: A historic 5 km route along the streets associated with the 1987 Brașov Revolt
An urban road route through Brașov, including historic and cultural landmarks
Children’s races from 250 m to 1.2 km, adapted for different age groups
additional: Registration is free and limited to 1,800 participants (1,500 adults and 300 children). Race kits can be collected the day before at the Sport Guru Brașov store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the SC Roman industrial park, right outside the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, where the revolt began. Running on the streets of Brașov, a 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the event offers a variety of routes, including a 50 km ultramarathon, team races, a half marathon, a cross-country race, and children’s races. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions while enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and refreshment stations. The event also includes a live broadcast, modern facilities, and prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and sweets
The final 12 km are predominantly downhill, with just one climb of more than 100 m
additional: The runner’s kit includes a race bib with timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a finisher’s medal, and access to hydration and refreshment stations offering sweet and savory products, still and sparkling water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruit. A refund policy is available if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also includes Play&Run children’s races and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Race distances include Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children’s races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and awards ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The 1 December Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, open to runners of all levels. The event offers an enjoyable sporting experience, with well-organized courses and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can receive race kits and attentive organizational support, helping ensure a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, bringing the community together for a worthy purpose.
course_highlights: Course held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Race kits handed directly to participants or to a representative with the required documents
Race kit collection available over the three days before the race
additional: Race kits can be collected over the three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (69 Unirii Boulevard) and ParkLake Shopping Center. Kits are handed only to the registered and validated participant, upon presentation of an identity document. Another person may collect a kit only with a signed copy of the participant’s identity document. For the teenagers’ race, the kit is handed only to the minor, accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a landmark event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail-running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. Now in its 9th edition, the main Ultra 50k race is a favorite among trail runners for the challenge and beauty of its course, which includes forests and spectacular climbs and descents. Participants can support one of Romania’s 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-stocked aid stations and personalized finisher medals. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: A 50 km course with climbs and descents through the forests around Cluj
Checkpoints and hydration stations offering a variety of refreshments (water, isotonic drinks, fruit, sweets, and savory food)
Views above Cluj-Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, the Poarta de su’ Feleac Museum, and the Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The race kit includes a race bib with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and live rankings, a personalized finisher medal, and access to aid stations serving sweet and savory foods, isotonic drinks, and fruit. There are children’s races and team races with special rules on the spacing between members. Cut-off times: 9h for Ultra 50k, 5h for Half 25k, 3h for Cross 15k, and 1h30 for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various historical regions of Romania and enjoy varied routes, from trail to cross-country, with registration open and early-bird prices available.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who want to support a worthy cause through sport. The event offers an enjoyable running experience in a friendly setting, promoting the local running community and social engagement. This is the first edition of the race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km course in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarios' Palliative Care Center for seriously ill children
Race options of 2 km (family, non-competitive) and 6 km (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on 11-12 December 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with 9,250 m of elevation gain, rated difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 m of elevation gain, rated intermediate. The race is known for its demanding mountain terrain and Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking a top-level endurance competition. Participants can track their performance on a personalized results dashboard.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with 4,600 m and 9,250 m of elevation gain, respectively
Mountain terrain rated intermediate and difficult
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event has a personalized dashboard for tracking participants’ results. No entry-fee details or start times are provided. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The “Pe Argeș în Jos” Half Marathon is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The courses start in Ștrand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a distinctive natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children’s races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is vibrant, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Ștrand Park, near the Summer Theatre
Course through Lunca Argeșului and Ștrand parks
Run along the Argeș River promenade, with picturesque views
additional: Race kit collection is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theatre for participants from outside Pitești. The half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races start at 10:00 in Ștrand Park. The children’s race starts at 12:30, and the awards ceremony is at 13:00. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal representative when registering and collecting their race kit. description: The Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon held on some of Bucharest’s most beautiful and fastest streets, offering both professional athletes and amateur runners the opportunity to achieve a competitive personal best. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a 3.5 km fun run for all ages. The race kit includes a bib with chip timing and a finisher’s medal, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on Bucharest’s main streets
World Athletics Label-certified half marathon course
Dedicated routes for the half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and the fun run
additional: The race kit must be collected in person at the Expo, upon presentation of an ID document. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for EUR 15. Participation for wheelchair users is free. The time limit is 3 hours for the half marathon and 1.5 hours for the 10 km race. Some streets will be closed during the event, so using public transport is recommended, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The course offers options for running and walking, with the opportunity to take part in record attempts; the event also includes other races, such as the 10 km and relay races.

description: Subcarpați Trail Run is a mountain running competition organized for trail running enthusiasts, offering a unique experience in the heart of Goruna Forest, in the Prahova Subcarpathians. The varied courses, from the Fun Race to the Ultramarathon, test runners’ endurance and perseverance in spectacular natural surroundings. The event brings together amateurs and professionals in a friendly, motivating atmosphere, with the start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii. It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Courses through Goruna Forest, with scenery of wooded hills
Distances and difficulty levels vary, from the 4 km Fun Race to the 75 km Ultramarathon with 2,800 m of elevation gain
Start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base in Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Race kits can be collected on Friday from 16:30 to 21:30 and on Saturday morning, depending on the race. The Ultramarathon starts at 06:00, the Marathon at 10:00, and the Half Marathon and Cross Country Race also at 10:00. The Fun Race starts after 11:45. Cash and product prizes are awarded to winners, including bonuses for course records. Varied courses, start and finish at the „Stejarul” Sports Base, on-site registration available, official photographers on the course.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 is a trail-running event held in the commune of Sălciua, situated between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, offering spectacular views. The event brings together people passionate about running, nature, culture and fun, offering an opportunity to escape the everyday and enjoy the beauty of nature with loved ones. The competition includes four races: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m), open to all participants who meet the age and registration requirements. The organizers provide a complete experience, with race kits, an awards ceremony and themed workshops for all ages.
course_highlights: Routes through nature reserves, hills and meadows
Areas with waterfalls and caves unique to the region
Natural setting between the Trascău Mountains and Muntele Mare, at an altitude of 700–1,400 m
additional: Race kit distribution on race day from 07:00 to 08:30. Starts in order: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) at 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) at 09:30, and Cursa Spiridușilor (400–800 m) at 10:00. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00. The event includes themed workshops for children and adults during breaks. Participation includes various race categories, with details about registration requirements and the schedule; all are scheduled for May 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional run organized in the heart of the Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolorului Square, bringing together participants of all ages in a festive atmosphere of friendly competition. The start is scheduled for 10:00, and the race celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic urban course steeped in tradition.
course_highlights: Start in Tricolorului Square, in the historic center of Târgoviște
Urban course with views of the Citadel and Chindia Tower
Event for all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The start area is in Tricolorului Square, Târgoviște. The event has a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, with a recommendation to bring suitable shoes and plenty of stamina. The event is part of Carpat Race and is supported by the local community, offering an opportunity to promote health and physical activity in Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este is a trail-running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, in a wooded, hilly area known as “Világlátó.” Participants can run or take part in Nordic walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, aiming to complete as many 1.6 km laps as possible, each with 60 m of elevation gain. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, with a friendly atmosphere, music, and a bar on site. It’s a great opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural, welcoming setting.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly terrain known as “Világlátó”
1.6 km lap with 60 m of elevation gain
2-, 4-, or 6-hour challenge, with a Nordic walking option
additional: Nordic walking poles are available in limited quantities by requesting them via email. There will be music and Wunderbar on site. Each participant receives a starter pack with a race bib and other promotional materials. The event combines running with a mental challenge, with participants aiming to complete as many laps as possible within their chosen time. A trail challenge with 1.6 km loops and running or Nordic walking options, held as part of Szent György Napok.

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, with no fixed finish line. Participants run to stay ahead of the Virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed until everyone is caught. The event in Oradea, Romania, on 10 May 2026, takes place on a 1.7 km paved circuit in the heart of the Nokian Tyres factory. All entry fees and donations go entirely toward spinal cord injury research.
course_highlights: 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory
Open to runners and wheelchair users
The Virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed
additional: The event is accessible to wheelchair participants. The start is simultaneous worldwide, and the Virtual Catcher Car begins the chase 30 minutes after the start at an initial speed of 14 km/h, increasing gradually. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord injury research projects. Participants can run any distance, with no fixed finish line, and can register through the app. Participants can run individually or in groups, and all funds raised go toward spinal cord injury research.

description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is an outdoor running event for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. The event offers three different races: a 2 km course for children and families, an intermediate 5 km course with short climbs and forest paths, and a 10 km course for runners seeking an authentic trail-running challenge. Participants can enjoy a supportive atmosphere, socializing, and fair play, with hydration points along the courses and a Starter Kit included for the 5 km and 10 km races.

A 5 km course with short climbs, forest paths, and views of the hills around the city of Năsăud

The event includes courses for all ages and levels, emphasizing nature, community, and fair play, with the start in Valea Caselor, Năsăud.

The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants receive access to hydration and refreshment points, medals, and prizes. Registration is limited and available online.

Participants are automatically entered into the raffle after the awards ceremony; attendance at the draw is mandatory. Trail race with multiple categories, picturesque mountain terrain, cultural and natural landmarks, registration open until September 2026, free participation for people with disabilities

Timotion is a movement of hearts united for good, with a tradition spanning more than 10 years and a continuously growing community.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 invites you to run in the heart of Transylvania, through the center of Târgu Mureș, on May 10, 2026. The event offers a range of races: 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4x5 km relay, and a children’s race. All start and finish in the central area, making it ideal for support from family and friends. Participants will discover the city’s notable tourist attractions in a vibrant spring atmosphere, enjoying prizes, medals, and good energy every step of the way. The organizer is Mureș Runners Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and community through sport.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș, passing notable tourist attractions
Start and finish in Piața Teatrului, in the city center
A range of events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, 4x5 km relay, and children’s race
additional: The registration package includes an official T-shirt, race number, timing chip, finisher medal, sponsor brochures, online certificates, official photos, and access to hydration and refreshment stations. Required equipment at the start includes running shoes, sportswear, and a clearly visible race number. The event promotes environmental protection; littering outside designated areas is prohibited. Participants can choose from several distances, including the half marathon, relay, and children’s race. The event promotes physical activity and local tourism in Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running is a mountain running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with Budureasa Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes two main races: the 8 km Eco Cross and the 16 km Cross, intended for endurance runners aged 14 and over. The routes start and finish in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with climbs and descents on gravel roads, trails, and paved roads. Refreshment points along the course provide water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. The race is open to all runners who are fit to participate, with special conditions for participants under 18.
course_highlights: The 8 km Eco Cross and 16 km Cross share a route until km 4.5, where there is a refreshment point
Steep climbs and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with 170 m of positive elevation gain
The final kilometers are on paved roads, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Race check-in takes place on Saturday from 16:00 to 20:00 or on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. The technical briefing is on Saturday, 09.05.2026, from 19:00 to 19:30, and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 refreshment points on the 16 km Cross course and 1 on the 8 km Eco Cross course, providing water, isotonic drinks, and fruit. Registrations are validated only after payment of the entry fee, and changes or cancellations can be made in writing only until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not eligible to participate. The route may be modified due to weather conditions; online registration is open until 3 May 2026, and registration may also be available on site; restrictions apply to minors; anti-doping rules apply.

description: The T.E.A.M. Fun Run is a charitable sporting event held in Timișoara, combining physical activity with solidarity to support children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association. The event is participatory, with no timing or rankings, and offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, with races for babies, children, and adults. The routes pass through central areas of the city, and the funds raised support the “Casa InimiiLor” project, a therapeutic refuge for children. Taking part is an expression of solidarity and hope for those in need.
course_highlights: The routes include Piața Libertății and Piața Victoriei, with distances adapted to age categories
A participatory event with no timing; all participants receive participation medals
Charitable support for children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association through the Casa InimiiLor project

Participants in the baby races are carried in a baby carrier or in their arms, while the children’s races have special rules regarding accompaniment by parents or legal guardians. There will be an official opening and a technical briefing before the start. The event promotes solidarity and community involvement, offering an opportunity to support children from the “Inima Îți Vorbește” Association by participating and donating.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 is a unique obstacle race in Romania, taking place on May 23 in Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. The courses are challenging, with significant elevation gain and a variety of obstacles designed to test participants’ physical endurance and willpower. The event offers an experience of initiation and reconnection with the spirit of the Dacian ancestors, combining athletic effort with tradition and authentic nature. Participants can choose from several events, ranging from 6 km to 21 km, each with its own challenges and obstacles. The atmosphere is one of camaraderie and competition, and after the race participants are invited to discover the local culture and enjoy its traditions and rituals.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km with 1,060 m of elevation gain and over 30 obstacles
Legend Run: 11.6 km with 690 m of elevation gain and 25 obstacles
Brave Run: 7.35 km with 348 m of elevation gain and 20 obstacles
additional: Registration validation and race-kit pickup take place on Friday, May 22, 2026, between 16:00 and 20:00 at Domeniul Satul Dacilor. The courses feature a variety of obstacles, including low fences, log jumps, rings, sandbags, a log pyramid, ropes, parallel bars, monkey bars, a muddy trench, a wall traverse, and a surprise obstacle. There are age- and gender-based prize categories, with cash prizes for the top finishers. The race is recommended for experienced participants, especially the Ultimate Run, which is a challenging OCR. The event offers different distance categories and courses and is open to both amateur and advanced runners.

description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 is an energetic 5-kilometer race full of positive energy, color, and fun, perfect for all ages and fitness levels. The event is untimed, focusing on the joy of running and the vibrant experience of having color applied at every kilometer. The urban course starts and finishes in Piața Unirii, offering a festival atmosphere with multiple consecutive starts and an explosion of colored powder at the finish. Participants receive a kit with a T-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

Colored powder applied at every kilometer
An explosion of colored powder at the finish, accompanied by live music

Bicycles, rollerblades, scooters, and pets are not allowed. The access wristband is issued at the entrance to the event area upon presentation of the participation number and T-shirt. The medal and colored powder are given at the finish. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, race number, bandana, tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle; pets and vehicles are not allowed on the course.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a top mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The competition includes Marathon, Half Marathon and Cross races, as well as a children’s race, EcoKids. The courses are made up of 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic running experience in nature, with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. The event promotes sustainable practices and takes place annually in May, bringing together runners of all levels.

Approximately 28 km half-marathon course with 1,350 m of positive elevation gain
Approximately 14 km cross-country course with 750 m of positive elevation gain, mostly on forest roads and mountain trails

Marathon participants will start at 9:00; the time will be displayed on their bib. There is a relaxation area and a Pasta Party after the race at Vlahia Inn. EcoKids has separate starts by age category, beginning at 15:00. Registration for the main races opens on March 8, 2026, and closes on May 1, 2026, subject to availability. Mountain trails, activities such as a pasta party and floral ceremonies, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge is a sub-mountain running competition held on marked trails in Turnu Roșu and on the hills at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering spectacular natural scenery and a challenge for all fitness levels. The event includes three races: a 21 km half marathon, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each suited to different types of participants, from experienced runners to those looking for a more relaxed experience. The organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socializing, offering amenities such as stretching sessions, post-run massage, camping, and activities for children. It’s an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.
course_highlights: Routes on natural trails, a forest road, and meadows
Spectacular scenery at the foot of the Făgăraș Mountains
Three races suited to all fitness levels

There is a painting workshop for children during the race. The routes include technical descents and pass through scenic areas, making them ideal for mountain trail-running enthusiasts.

description: The Nisipului Run & Fun Marathon, taking place on May 17, 2026, at Zoom Beach in Constanța, is a sporting event that combines competition with fun and the promotion of a healthy lifestyle. The event offers six different races, from the 42 km marathon to recreational runs for the whole family, held on the sand of the Romanian coast. Participants can enjoy spectacular routes with the sea breeze, in an atmosphere full of energy and community spirit. The marathon is a celebration of movement, nature, and adventure, aimed at both professional and amateur runners.
course_highlights: Routes on the sand of the Romanian coast with the sea breeze
Water stations at the start/finish and at km 2.5 on Reyna Beach
A moderately challenging course, with multiple loops and clear markings
additional: The start will be in the vibrant heart of Constanța on May 17, 2026. The marathon course consists of 7 km loops on sand, with a 6-hour time limit. Race changes are free until 01.05.2026; after that, an additional fee applies. Participation kits will not be sent by courier if a participant does not attend. Multiple race categories, routes on the coastal sand, activities for families and the community, and an event promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Prima Evadare
description: Prima Evadare is the largest cross-country cycling marathon in Romania, held annually on a classic route between Bucharest and Snagov. The race offers a friendly and accessible experience, with a distance of approximately 55 km through forests and country roads, with no significant elevation changes. The event brings together cycling enthusiasts from across the country, creating an energetic and welcoming atmosphere, ideal for kicking off the MTB marathon season.
course_highlights: Approximately 55 km through forests and country roads
No significant elevation changes, making for an accessible experience
The classic Bucharest–Snagov route
additional: Race packs can be collected on the Friday and Saturday before the race at Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participants can expect a varied route with natural terrain and diverse scenery, making this a landmark mountain biking event in Romania.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a fully supported, 3-day ultramarathon held on scenic mountain trails in Romania’s Carpathian Mountains, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and villages with a rich culture, and is suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races, such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun and Fun Run, offering participants a range of options. After the race, participants are invited to an awards ceremony and a traditional party with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognised, awards iTRA points and has been voted among the 50 best ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: A 100 km route across mountain trails, mineral-water streams and traditional villages
Spectacular scenery with green pastures and the authentic sounds of bells and running water
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: A jacket/hoodie is included only for registrations made by 1 May 2026. The event awards finishers 3 iTRA points. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and a party with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race; the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, awards iTRA points and attracts international participants.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines, with numerous climbs and descents, all starting and finishing at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognised as a UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior mountain-running experience for the longer races, and everyone who finishes within the time limits receives a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Routes through narrow trails and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines
Start and finish near Bran Castle
additional: SportHG technical T-shirts are available until 1 May 2026, after which they will be replaced by neck warmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between checkpoints. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail-running experience, and registration is online, with limited places.

description: Sibiu International Marathon is Romania’s largest philanthropic running event, reaching its 15th edition in 2026. The event combines the joy of running with support for community projects, with runners able to choose to support various local causes through their entry fee. The event features multiple races for all ages and levels, from the full marathon to children’s races, held in Sibiu’s Great Square and surrounding areas. It is a movement that unites and inspires communities, with a strong tradition and significant social impact.
course_highlights: Multiple races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, relay and children’s races
Start and finish in Great Square, Sibiu
A philanthropic event supporting local community projects
additional: Entry fees are considered donations supporting community projects. The event includes races for all ages, including children’s races and a relay. The registration deadline is 4 May 2026. It features multiple races, a registration deadline of 4 May 2026, donation-based fees, and a focus on social and community causes.

name: BRASOV MARATHON Eveniment organizat de CPNT Brașov
description: Brașov Marathon is one of Romania’s largest mountain running events, held in the heart of the Carpathians, around the city of Brașov. The courses include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon, crossing the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs and offering impressive views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in Piața Sfatului, passes historic and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, offering ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Mountain routes across the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs
Start and finish in Piața Sfatului, passing the Black Church and the Weavers’ Bastion
Panoramic views of Brașov and the surrounding area
additional: Race kits can be collected in Piața Sfatului, with specific hours for each race. The Ultra Marathon starts at 08:00, while the Half Marathon starts in two waves. Mandatory gear checks apply to the Ultra Marathon, Marathon, and Half Marathon. The event also includes races for children and teenagers, held over three days. The start area offers refreshments between 10:30 and 23:00. The event includes races for children and people with special abilities, and is dedicated to promoting running, nature, and the local community.

location: Castelul Bethlen-Haller, Cetatea de Baltă, Alba, Romania

description: Jidvei Weinland Trails is a unique sporting event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle, in the heart of Transylvania. The event combines running and cycling on scenic routes through the Jidvei vineyards, offering participants spectacular views and an authentic experience surrounded by nature. It includes races for all fitness levels, from children to adults, as well as recreational and food-and-wine activities for the whole family. It is a celebration of sport, culture, and local tradition, with a friendly and safe atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes through vineyards and ancient forests
Spectacular scenery in the Jidvei vineyards, in the heart of Transylvania
Event held on the grounds of Bethlen-Haller Castle
additional: Race kits for the 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, as well as the 1 km and 2 km children’s races. Prizes for the youngest runners. Relaxation activities and food-and-wine experiences are included in the event. The organizers are preparing a fun-filled world and creative workshops for children in a safe, friendly setting. Participants can choose from 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km races. The event also includes a grape-picking competition, guided tours, activities for children, charitable donations, and wine and traditional food tastings.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run is a night running race in the heart of Bucovina, offering spectacular routes and a festival atmosphere beneath the stars. The event promotes outdoor activity and a healthy lifestyle, engages the local community, and supports the education of disadvantaged children. Participants can choose from several distances, from a half marathon to children’s races, and enjoy an authentic experience in nature, with hydration points, a hot meal, and prizes. The festival combines sport with a friendly atmosphere and environmental responsibility.
course_highlights: Spectacular night routes through the forests and ridges of Bucovina
Hydration and food points along the route
Festival atmosphere with general admission and a hot meal at the finish
additional: Participants receive a personalized race bib with a timing chip, access to hydration and food points, a general admission wristband for the festival area, a hot meal at the finish, and cash prizes in the age-group and OPEN categories. The festival offers accommodation options at a campsite or partner hotels and recommends traveling by train or bus to reduce environmental impact. Multiple race distances, festival atmosphere, prizes, real-time results, participant amenities, charitable purpose

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the area around Lake Mujdeni, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers varied courses for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, and is dedicated to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked courses and significant elevation gain, set in picturesque natural surroundings. The organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the event’s competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon course: 44 km with 1,180 m of elevation gain
MTB Race course: 34 km with 930 m of elevation gain
Trail Running Half Marathon course: 25 km with 990 m of elevation gain
additional: The courses have significant elevation gain, ranging from 184 m for the Fun Run (6 km) to 1,180 m for the MTB Marathon (44 km). Minors must have written consent from a parent or guardian to register. The organizer is the Transylvanian Carpathian Society - Satu Mare. Telephone contact: +40-743-419443. Registration is exclusively online, and the event includes courses ranging from 6 km to marathon distance, suited to different fitness levels.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultramarathon held in Ion Creangă Children’s Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a 1,222.75-meter paved course, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and enthusiasts of endurance running, offering a transformative experience and an exceptional mental and physical challenge. There are also 50 km and 100 km races, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: A 1,222.75-meter paved course in Ion Creangă Children’s Park
The course is illuminated at night for runners’ safety
Two hydration and nutrition stations along the course, offering water, glucose, electrolytes, fruit, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal gear, food, and sleeping bags. Race kits must be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except relays. The event includes a runners’ briefing and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved, illuminated course, with the option to participate in several distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race held in Timișoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting wounded military personnel. The event promotes a winning spirit and national values through sport as part of the Invictus Romania project. The fourth edition continues the tradition of bringing runners and supporters together in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support wounded military personnel.
course_highlights: Symbolic courses in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
An event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition spanning more than a decade
additional: The event is part of a broader Invictus Romania project, which also includes other sporting competitions and activities supporting wounded military personnel. Official Invictus Heroes Half Marathon T-shirts are available for supporters. No details were found about start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timișoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

name: TRANSYLVANIA 100K
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain ultramarathon event held in the wilderness of the Bucegi Mountains, crossing high-altitude trails. The event includes five different races, ranging from a half marathon to a 100 km ultramarathon, all starting and finishing near Bran Castle, known as Dracula’s Castle. The routes offer a unique experience for mountain-running enthusiasts, combining narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridgelines. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special keepsakes for those who finish within the time limits.
course_highlights: Mountain trails featuring narrow paths and ancient forests
Routes across mountain plateaus and exposed ridgelines in the Bucegi Mountains
Start and finish near Bran Castle, an iconic landmark
additional: Previous experience on mountain trails is required for registration, with different requirements depending on the distance. After 1 May 2026, SportHG technical T-shirts will be replaced with neck gaiters. Places are limited, and registrations are confirmed after online payment and verification of previous experience. The event also includes other mountain races, such as a skyrace and a half marathon, and offers prizes and finisher mementos.

name: Bușteni Ultra Race
description: Bușteni Ultra Race is a mountain running competition held on spectacular routes in the Bucegi and Baiului Mountains, offering impressive panoramic views. The event features four distances with significant elevation gain, designed to test participants’ physical and mental limits. The atmosphere is one of community and mutual support, while careful organization ensures a safe and professional experience. Participants can reconnect with nature and take on the challenge of an authentic endurance race.

Marked routes and well-stocked aid stations

A growing local tradition, it brings athletes and supporters together for a memorable experience.

Short, accessible routes for families and children within the fairground

The main races start at 09:00, while the Family and Mini races start at 09:15. Gear checks are mandatory for safety. The awards ceremony begins at 18:00, followed by a campfire. Competitor parking is provided in a specially designated area beside the Blidăreasa forest road, accessible from the locality of Bistra Mureșului. Mountain trails, registration details, and the event schedule; registration closes on June 6, 2026.

name: PENIEL TRAIL RUN
description: Peniel Trail Run is an outdoor running event held on trail routes in the Bistrița area, promoting health through movement, community, and truth. The event offers races for all levels, from a half marathon for experienced runners to 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s race. Peniel Trail Run is more than a sporting competition: it is a call to live life fully in body, mind, and spirit, with a profound message of direction and a living relationship with God. The name Peniel symbolizes “the place of encounter,” where sport, community, and faith meet in an authentic way that is relevant to today’s generation.
course_highlights: Trail routes in the Bistrița area, set in nature
Half marathon for experienced runners
Accessible 5 km and 10 km races for all levels
additional: The event includes races for children (Cross Kids). Technical details and course maps will be updated on the website at a later date. Event T-shirts are provided, with a size guide. Trail running in nature, promoting health, community, and faith, with multiple race categories for all ages.

name: Run for Heroes
description: Run for Heroes is an annual charity race taking place on June 14, 2026, in Herăstrău Park, Bucharest, on Șoseaua Kiseleff. The event brings together runners of all ages, families, and pets to support free psychotherapy services. The courses are accessible and beginner-friendly, with an energetic atmosphere full of fun and solidarity, where every kilometer run contributes to a worthy cause. Participants receive superhero-themed race kits and enjoy a full day of sports and recreational activities.
course_highlights: Flat, fully marked urban routes suitable for beginners and experienced runners
A dedicated route accessible to people with disabilities
A welcoming atmosphere for families, children, and pets
additional: The race kit includes an official T-shirt, superhero cape, themed accessories, a goodie bag, a race bib, and a medal. Medical assistance and hydration stations are available along the route. The event offers dedicated areas for families, children, pets, and people with disabilities, as well as secure bag storage, a security team, and volunteers to provide guidance. After the race, participants can enjoy sports and wellness activities, children's workshops, themed photo booths, and relaxation areas. Charity event, recreational activities, areas for families and children, kits with T-shirts and accessories, hydration and first-aid stations.

name: Topoloveni Summer Tour ~ 2026
description: Topoloveni Summer Tour is an event for amateur cyclists in Romania, organized by Riders Club. Participants can choose to enjoy a ride outdoors or compete for a place in the national amateur cycling rankings. The route is carefully planned to protect the natural environment, and markings will be limited to respect the forests and natural areas. The event offers opportunities for all ages, including children’s races and options for families with special discounts. In the event of unfavorable weather conditions, the race may be rescheduled to a reserve date.
course_highlights: Route carefully marked to protect forests and natural areas
Route markings will be shared in the Participant Guide during event week
Start location accessible via Google Maps
additional: The event is limited to 1,000 starting places. The reserve race date is June 20, 2026. Children aged 5 to 13 must have a personal account on the Riders Club platform and be registered; they are recommended to be accompanied on the route. Families receive a 20% discount for a minimum of 3 people. E-MTB races allow electric bikes with motors that provide pedal assistance only, with a single battery for the entire race. Advance registration is required. The event is open to all experience levels, with the option to compete in electric races and prizes for participants.

description: Urlea Super Vertical is an extreme mountain race set amid the wild landscapes of the Făgăraș Mountains, offering a unique vertical running experience and an intense descent. It is Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, where one partner climbs while the other descends, adding an innovative and spectacular element to the competition. The 12 km course, with 1,833 m of elevation gain, tests runners’ endurance and technique across forest roads, woodland trails and alpine pastures. The event is for those seeking pure adrenaline and an intense mountain challenge, with a revolutionary awards system that rewards individual and team performance.
course_highlights: 12 km course with 1,833 m of elevation gain, reaching an altitude of 2,474 m
Romania’s first and only up-and-down relay, with one partner climbing while the other descends
Varied terrain: forest roads, logging roads, trails through deciduous and coniferous forests, and alpine pasture
additional: A revolutionary awards system with individual and team rankings, cash prizes for teams, and bonuses for individual performances. The race kit includes a personalized race number (for early registrations), a finisher’s medal engraved in stone, a superlight technical singlet for the first 300 registrants, aid and hydration stations, medical support, and access to educational sessions and workshops. Parking is available for 360 cars. Payment is by bank card only, and registration is valid only after full payment. The event includes race-kit pickup, tent accommodation and accommodation suggestions, as well as the race start and awards ceremony on race day.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Târnava Marathon is a trail-running event organized by the Târnăveni Cycling Association in collaboration with Ruck Ventilatoare, held in the municipality of Târnăveni, Mureș County. Now in its 10th edition, the marathon promotes a healthy lifestyle and running in nature, aiming to improve environmental education and raise awareness of the benefits of outdoor sports. The start and finish are located on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare, and the competition offers several trail-running courses for all ages and levels. The event brings together a community of athletes passionate about running and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the premises of Ruck Ventilatoare
A variety of trail-running courses: half marathon 21 km, 10 km cross-country race, 4 km cross-country race, and Kids Trail Running
Event held in the Transylvania region, surrounded by nature
additional: Race kits can be collected on the day before and on race day, on the premises of the Ruck Ventilatoare factory. A fitness instructor leads a warm-up before the start. Children’s races are organized by age group. After the competition, there is a Gulaș Party, a concert, and an awards ceremony. Participants can choose from the 21 km, 10 km, and 4 km courses, as well as children’s races, with activities including kit collection, races, and awards ceremonies.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș is a traditional mountain running competition, now in its 17th edition, bringing together runners and mountain lovers from across the region. The event offers two races in an authentic mountain setting, with substantial elevation gain and spectacular scenery. The courses include a 14 km Cross with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain and a Half Marathon of approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain. Participants receive a race kit, access to hydration points, and medical support. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.
course_highlights: Cross course: 14 km with 1,000 m of positive elevation gain, sustained climbs, and technical descents
Half Marathon course: approximately 23 km with 1,450 m of positive elevation gain, offering an additional challenge
Spectacular scenery and hydration points along the route
additional: The start is at Podul Berdu, in the Ferneziu neighborhood, at the base of Lake Firiza. The routes are marked with ribbons, signs, and paint. The race kit includes a chip-equipped bib, T-shirt, medal, access to refreshment points, medical support, and a guide. The finish is at Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, the event’s main partner. The courses are on mountain terrain. Registration closes on June 9, 2026. Participation includes a kit with a bib, T-shirt, medal, and hydration points. The event takes place on June 20, 2026.

The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race for families, making it suitable for runners of all ages and levels. Organizers Runners Club promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Held in June, the race swaps urban asphalt for nature and offers an outdoor running experience.
course_highlights: Route along the shady trails of Hoia Forest
15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, plus a family race
Outdoor event in a natural setting
additional: The registration package includes a race bib and other benefits. Awards are presented by category. The event is organized by Runners Club, which supports free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. The event takes place in Hoia Forest, with online registration and medals for participants. The route includes natural trails and is suitable for runners of all ages and levels.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: The Roșia Montană Marathon is a celebration of nature, history, and cultural heritage, held in the heart of the Apuseni Mountains, in the commune of Roșia Montană. The varied routes, which include mountain trails, local roads, and paved sections, offer a unique experience for both trail runners and road runners. The event includes races for all ages, including the Kids’ Race, which follows age-appropriate routes in the town’s historic center. Along the way, participants can admire the natural scenery and centuries-old architectural heritage.
course_highlights: Varied routes with elevation changes along mountain trails and local roads
Natural scenery in the Apuseni Mountains and Roșia Montană’s historic architectural heritage
The Kids’ Race follows age-appropriate routes in the historic center
additional: The Kids’ Race has different routes depending on age, from 700 m for children aged 0–10 (with a parent/guardian required for ages 0–6) to 2.3 km for children aged 13–16. The start and finish are in Piața Centrală in Roșia Montană. The event also includes other races: Marathon 42.16 km, Half Marathon 25.2 km, and 10 km Cross-Country Race. Race kits can be collected in Piața Centrală the day before, and the program also includes cultural activities and concerts. The Kids’ Race includes three different routes (700 m, 1.3 km, and 2.3 km), with prizes and medals for participants. The event takes place on June 21, 2026, in the commune’s historic center, and promotes the area’s cultural and ecological values.

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails is a mountain running race taking place on July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort in Fundata, crossing three mountain ranges: the Bucegi Mountains, the Leaota Mountains, and the Piatra Craiului Mountains. The event offers six individual race options, ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon, suitable for all experience levels. Participants can enjoy spectacular scenery and a unique experience in nature in a friendly, well-organized setting. Registration is limited and available online until June 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Routes crossing three mountain ranges: Bucegi, Leaota, and Piatra Craiului
Distances ranging from 6 km to a 102 km ultramarathon
Spectacular natural scenery in the Cheile Grădiștei area
additional: All races start on the same day, July 4, 2026, at Cheile Grădiștei Resort, the event’s hub. Registration is limited and available online. The organizer may award wildcards to recognized athletes. The event is supported by participant donations, sponsors, and partners. The code of conduct is mandatory for all participants to protect the trails and ensure safety. Participation is through an online form, with limited registration and the possibility of wildcards for recognized athletes. The event takes place on July 4, 2026, in Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race is a mountain running competition held in the Rodnei Mountains, in the Borșa area of Maramureș. The event offers three distinct courses suited to different experience levels: the Puzdrelor course, the most difficult, for experienced runners; the Gărgălău course, a moderate challenge for well-prepared runners; and the Musceta course, a fast route with a large elevation drop. The race is part of the Carpathians Circuit and focuses on the experience of running in nature amid spectacular mountain scenery. The organizers invite families and mountain sports enthusiasts to enjoy an active weekend outdoors.
course_highlights: Puzdrelor course: 29.5 km with 2200 m of elevation gain, recommended for experienced runners
Gărgălău course: 21 km with 1300-1500 m of elevation gain, suitable for well-prepared but less experienced runners
Musceta course: 16 km with 500 m of ascent and 1500 m of descent, a fast and technical route
additional: The race takes place in Borșa, in the Rodnei Mountains, a mountainous area with spectacular scenery and a tradition of mountain sports. There are several accommodation options near the start, from guesthouses to campsites, between 190 m and 17.6 km from the start. The courses combine marked and unmarked trails, forest roads, and steep slopes, offering an authentic mountain-running experience. The race is part of the Carpathians Mountain Running Circuit. The mountain course requires a mandatory equipment check and starts at the base of the Borșa gondola. GPX downloads and information about accommodation and registration are available. Entry fees include hydration stations, photos, goulash, and parking access.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță is a spectacular mountain race starting and finishing in Sinaia Town Hall Square. The routes pass through picturesque areas such as Cota 1000 and Cota 1400, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The event is open to both elite runners and mountain-running enthusiasts, with 10K and 21K races. Participants receive a race kit with a race number, timing chip, and medal, and the organizers provide free digital photo galleries.
course_highlights: Mountain route with climbs up to Cota 1000 and Cota 1400
Passes through tourist areas marked with red and yellow trail markers
Start and finish in Sinaia Town Hall Square, on Bd. Carol
additional: Race kits can be collected in person only, upon presentation of an identity document. The time limit for completing the 10K route is 4.5 hours, and for the 21K it is 6 hours. Minors aged 14 to 18 may participate only when accompanied by an adult and with written consent. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 50 RON, while the special children’s T-shirt is free. Only participants with a valid race number, officials, and authorized personnel are allowed on the route. The routes feature varied mountain terrain, with details about the races and cultural and historical attractions in the area, such as Peleș Castle and Sinaia Monastery.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival is an international road-running event held in the heart of Cluj, bringing together elite athletes, thousands of amateur runners, and children. The festival combines competitive sport with the joy of movement and the energy of the city, offering a flat, fast course ideal for runners of all levels. The event includes races for children, open 5 km and 10 km races, and an elite race featuring top international athletes. Cluj-Napoca, a young and active city, provides the perfect setting for this celebration of running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course in the heart of Cluj-Napoca
Races for children with distances adapted to their ages
International and Romanian elite athletes
additional: Children’s races take place on Saturday, June 27, and adult and elite races on Sunday, June 28. Children’s distances: 800 m (ages 6–9), 1,200 m (ages 10–13), 3,000 m (ages 13–15). Amateur races: 5 km (minimum age 14), 10 km (minimum age 16). The event is organized by the team behind Brașov Running Festival. All participants in the children’s races receive medals and surprises. The event includes children’s races, open categories, and an international elite competition with a World Athletics label; it takes place in Cluj-Napoca and promotes urban running.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: The Mioveni City Run is an annual sporting event organized by the Invictus Mioveni Association in partnership with Mioveni City Hall and the city’s Cultural Center. The event brings together runners of all ages, from children aged 3 to seniors aged 78, on varied 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses, as well as special races for little ones. The atmosphere is vibrant, with music, applause, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances, making for a day dedicated to health, community and sporting fun. The run is a celebration of movement and community spirit, supported by major sponsors such as TEMAD, WD-40 Romania and UHU Romania.
course_highlights: 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km courses in Mioveni’s Civic Center
Special “DINO” races for children
A vibrant atmosphere with music, SMURD demonstrations and artistic performances
additional: The event includes raffles with prizes and surprises for participants, provided by sponsors such as UHU and WD-40. Participants include both adults and children; the youngest runner was 3 years old, and the oldest was 78. Courses of 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, races for children, an event promoting health and sport, and support from sponsors TEMAD, WD-40 and UHU Romania.

The event includes 15 km, 7 km and 3 km races, as well as a race dedicated to families, making it suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, foster a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. The race is a great opportunity to trade urban pavement for fresh air and the beautiful scenery of the forest.
course_highlights: Routes along cool trails in Hoia Forest
A range of races: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km and the family race
An event suitable for all ages and running levels
additional: The registration package includes a technical T-shirt and race bib. Prizes are awarded to winners in each race. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. Route along the trails of Hoia Forest; online registration; the fee includes a medal, timing and medical assistance.
