location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: The Mioveni City Cross-Country Run is a sporting event organized by Invictus România, dedicated to promoting a spirit of solidarity and courage, especially among wounded military personnel. The event takes place in the civic center of Mioveni and is part of a series of charitable and commemorative sporting competitions. Participants are encouraged to join in support of the values of honor and respect, in a friendly and motivating setting.
course_highlights: Course through the civic center of Mioveni
Event dedicated to wounded military personnel and war veterans
An atmosphere of solidarity and community support
additional: The event includes several sporting activities, but details about the course and registration are not specified

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail is a mountain running competition held over three days in the heart of the Sălaj Mountains. The event offers a variety of races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, including a 103 km ultra race with over 5,000 m of elevation gain. ZUT is more than a competition: it is a platform that brings together athletes, the local community, and nature, promoting a spirit of adventure and respect for the environment. The routes are challenging and spectacular, offering an authentic trail-running experience amid impressive natural landscapes.
course_highlights: 103 km ULTRA course with 5,255 m of elevation gain
Well-equipped aid and checkpoint stations along the route
A variety of races, from a 2.5 km children’s race to a 103 km ultra
additional: The event takes place over 3 days, with multiple races suited to different levels of fitness. The Last Man Standing race is a special endurance competition with 6.7 km laps every hour, eliminating participants who do not finish in time. There are prize categories for children and Cross races. Mandatory equipment is specified in the regulations, and aid stations provide water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and hot food along the ultra course. Multiple race distances, including races for children and charity events; an emphasis on promoting local values and community spirit; the event also includes an environmental awareness component.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run is a mountain running event held in Predeal, Brașov, on July 11, 2026. The event offers five trail-running routes suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 13 km to 38 km. The routes pass through forests, mountain trails, and areas with spectacular scenery, offering a complete mountain-running experience. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and active running community, making it an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the Piatra Mare Mountains.
course_highlights: 100% trail-running routes through forests and along mountain trails
Challenging climbs, including more than 500 m of elevation gain over 4 km on K24
Spectacular scenery at Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare, and Cabana Garbova
additional: The event includes five races: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton, and Family Run (non-competitive). The start is at the base of the Clăbucet ski slopes. The routes are marked with yellow tape bearing the red Predeal Forest Run logo and are supported by volunteers. Cut-off times and aid stations are set for the competitive races. The race kit will be announced later. Participants can register in various race categories, and the event promotes a social cause. Registration details and rules are available on the official website.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei is a mountain running race held in Slănic Moldova, offering spectacular routes through cool forests and along the ridges of the Nemira Massif. Participants enjoy a well-marked course featuring wild natural scenery and alpine challenges, suited to experienced runners. The event is appreciated for its careful organization, dedicated volunteers, and friendly atmosphere, making it a memorable experience for mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Routes through shady forests and alpine areas with wild natural scenery
90% tourist-trail marking, with additional signage in difficult sections
Significant elevation changes, with spectacular climbs and descents
additional: The routes include a marathon, half marathon, and cross-country race, with positive elevation gains ranging from 700 m to 2400 m. The start is in the Central Park of the Slănic Moldova resort. The routes are 80–90% runnable, with sections of forest road, alpine trails, and rugged terrain. The organizers recommend mountain experience and appropriate equipment. There is also a children’s race to encourage running in nature. The event also includes routes for children, with an emphasis on ecotourism and community involvement, and offers information about registration, accommodation, and routes.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run is a mountain running competition held in the Cozia Massif, on the left bank of the Olt River, in the spa resort of Călimănești-Căciulata. The event, organized by the Pegas Triatlon Club Association with the support of local authorities, promotes mountain running, local traditions, and humanitarian fundraising. Participants take on three challenging, unmarked mountain routes that require mountain experience and skills. The atmosphere is friendly and energizing, and after the race all runners are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery.
course_highlights: Unmarked mountain routes with significant elevation gain (e.g. 30 km with 2,000 m of elevation gain)
Routes passing through villages, alpine pastures, wooded areas, and mountain ridges
Routes including sections with fixed ropes and rough terrain, requiring mountain experience
additional: Race bibs are distributed in two sessions: Friday evening and Saturday morning. The Cozia (30 km) and Stănișoara (21 km) routes start at 08:00, while the Turnu route (4 km) starts at 09:00. There is an 8-hour time limit for the Cozia and Stănișoara routes. The children’s race takes place at Turnu Monastery Camping, starting at 16:00, and registration for children is free. After the race, all participants are invited to lunch at Turnu Monastery after the Holy Liturgy. Mountain routes, an 8-hour time limit, participants over 18 years old, an emphasis on running and hiking, and the promotion of local natural and cultural attractions

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race is a mountain running competition held amid the spectacular scenery of the Carpathian Mountains, at the Stâna de Vale resort in Bihor County. The event is part of the EMA Off-Road Running 2026 circuit and offers races for all levels, from beginner routes to demanding mountain ultramarathons. Participants can enjoy well-marked routes, full support along the course, and a friendly post-race atmosphere. The race weekend also includes an 8 km vertical race, a classic 11 km race, and a long 33 km race with significant elevation gain.
course_highlights: A 33 km mountain route with 1,500 m of positive elevation gain, featuring technical sections and panoramic views
An 11 km route suited to beginners and intermediate runners, through forests and gentle hills
An 8 km vertical race with 1,100 m of elevation gain, featuring a continuous, demanding climb
additional: The event takes place on 10–11 July 2026, with race-pack collection at Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. The Vertical 8K starts on Friday at 10:00, while the 33 km and 11 km races start on Saturday at 08:30 and 09:30. The organizers provide a post-race meal and a party after the awards ceremony. Participation in the EMA circuit requires a valid license for the 35–79 age category. The routes are on mountain terrain, and the event includes timing. Participants can choose between two distances to suit their fitness level.

name: BUILA TRAIL RACE Discover Oltenia de sub munte!
description: Buila Trail Race 2026 is a mountain running event organized by the Sport fără Limite Vâlcea Association, promoting the beauty of Buila-Vânturarița National Park. The event takes place on July 18, 2026, in Bărbătești, Vâlcea, and offers a range of races for all ages and fitness levels. Participants can choose from children’s races, cross-country races, and mountain courses of 11, 18, and 36 km, all featuring spectacular scenery and authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in Buila-Vânturarița National Park
Spectacular scenery and protected nature
A range of events: children’s races, an 11 km cross-country race, and 18 km and 36 km courses
additional: The event promotes ecotourism, nature, and local culture, offering an opportunity for trail running and mountain hiking enthusiasts.

name: Maraton Bate Toaca
description: Maraton Bate Toaca is an annual mountain race held in the Durău area, NT, and is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The event offers two main courses: the 18 km Dochia Race, with approximately 1500 m of elevation gain, and the 31 km Bate Toaca Race, with approximately 2700 m of elevation gain. The courses pass through spectacular scenery, including Cabana Dochia, Vf. Lespezi, and Vf. Toaca, offering runners an authentic and challenging mountain experience. The organizers provide a friendly atmosphere and good logistics for participants.
course_highlights: Mountain courses with significant elevation gains (1500 m and 2700 m)
Spectacular scenery in the Durău area, including Vf. Toaca and Cabana Dochia
Marked courses with various symbols (red stripe, yellow triangle, red cross, red dot)
additional: The courses are well marked with different symbols and include climbs and descents on stairs at Vf. Toaca. The Bate Toaca Race is part of the Carpathians Circuit. The organizer is Asociația SPORT.NATURA Piatra Neamț. Telephone contact is available for logistics and the secretariat. The event also includes results and rules from previous editions, as well as information about registration and participation.

name: BURDUF CHALLENGE Alergăm pentru brânză și colibe!
price_range: semi-maraton 200 Lei, cros 175 Lei, cursele copiilor 50 Lei
description: Burduf Challenge is a mountain running race held in Râu Sadului, Sibiu, on 18 July 2026. The event features three races on scenic subalpine routes with significant elevation gain, for adults as well as children and teenagers. Participation supports the Țara Colibelor project through a donation included in the entry fee, and after the race runners are invited to a brunch featuring local products. The event promotes ecotourism and the preservation of mountain cultural heritage in the Cindrel and Lotrului Mountains.
course_highlights: Scenic subalpine routes with elevation gains ranging from +30 m to +1000 m
14 km cross-country race with +900 m elevation gain and 21 km half marathon with +1000 m elevation gain
Routes for children and teenagers with modest elevation gain, adapted to age
additional: Race bib pickup is from 06:30 to 07:30, the technical briefing is at 07:45, the adult race starts at 09:00, and the children’s race starts at 11:00. Hydration stations are available every 5 km along the route. Parking is available at the school in the village centre and in the Beberani area, approximately 100 m from the start.
